info.title: Farmess API
info.description: Server route handlers for Farmess (Next.js App Router). Authentication is the Supabase SSR session cookie set by /login — sign in on the same origin, then use "Try it out". Role checks run in every handler and Row Level Security is enforced in PostgreSQL. Sessions end after 30 minutes without activity and 12 hours after sign-in (admin accounts: 15 minutes and 8 hours); a request on an ended session is answered 401 with code `session_expired`. Errors are JSON objects with an `error` message; 401 = not signed in, 403 = wrong role or not the record owner, 409 = state conflict, 503 = provider or key unavailable (no data is ever fabricated).

get.summary: Price trend plus statistical, machine-learning and weather-aware forecasts for a crop at a mandi, from saved AGMARKNET reports

200.description: status is choose_crop, no_saved_prices, insufficient_history, trend_only or forecast

get.description: Uses saved market_observations; renamed listings of one mandi are joined. The crop name is matched to the source's spelling ("tomatoes" -> "Tomato"). The requested district is matched to the district names in the saved reports (data.gov.in writes East Champaran as "East Champaran/ Motihari"; a name is used only when it fits the requested district better than any other district of the state) and `area.sourceDistrict` gives that name when it differs. If no mandi in the requested district reports the crop, mandis elsewhere in the state are returned and `area.widened` is true. Returns `result` (statistical model on this mandi: forecast, trend_only or insufficient_history), `ml` (gradient-boosted trees pooled across all saved crops and mandis in the state) and `weather` (gradient-boosted trees over every mandi of this crop in the state with each district's rain and temperature from Open-Meteo; includes dry / as-forecast / heavy-rain scenario prices), plus `weatherOutlook` (next 7 days for the mandi's district). Each forecast is returned only when it beats the "price stays the same" baseline on recent reports it never saw; the weather model is tested with weather known on the forecast day only. When market is omitted, the mandi still reporting with the most saved report days is used.

post.summary: Make sure Farmess has a crop's prices for an area; starts a background fetch from data.gov.in when something is missing
post.description: Any signed-in account. Reports what is saved for the crop in the district (or the state when no district is given or the district has no reports) and, when today's reports, newer days or older history are missing, starts fetching them in the background: today's reports from the current-day resource, up to 12 months of history for a district (4 months for a whole state), then the weather of the districts where the crop is reported. The district is asked for under the name data.gov.in uses for it ("East Champaran/ Motihari" for East Champaran), taken from saved reports and a checked list; a district the source lists under two names is fetched under both. If the source has no mandi in the district for the crop, the state is fetched instead. The newest rows are saved within seconds and the rest as they arrive. One fetch runs per crop and area at a time; when the source answers "slow down" (HTTP 429) the fetch keeps trying for about three minutes, and later attempts are spaced out (complete: 6 h, stopped at the time limit: 1 min, rate-limited: 3 min, source unreachable: 5 min, nothing at the source: 24 h). Rows are validated and written by a database function that only the server can call. Safe to call repeatedly; the forecast panel polls it while a fetch is running or about to be retried.

200.description: configured, crop (source spelling), state, district, sourceDistrict (the district as data.gov.in writes it, or null), scope (district or state), savedReports, newestDate, oldestDate, needed, reason (nothing_saved, newer_days, older_days, up_to_date, no_location, not_configured, unavailable), started, weatherStarted, and runs {district, state}: for each, null or {state (running, complete, partial, rate_limited, source_error, no_data, save_error), saved, retryInSeconds, slowedDown}. runs is what this server instance knows about the latest fetch and may be null on another instance.

get.summary: The caller's sales (as farmer or buyer) with status, the other side's contact details and ratings

patch.summary: Move a sale forward: dispatch (farmer), confirm_delivery (buyer), confirm_payment (farmer)
patch.description: Each side confirms only its own step, in order. The change is recorded in the sale timeline and the other side is notified.

get.summary: The caller's own rating summary and the ratings they have received

post.summary: Rate the other side of a completed sale or service request, once, from 1 to 5 stars
post.description: Allowed only for a participant, after a sale is delivered or paid or a service request is completed. One rating per person per sale or request; it cannot be changed. Others see only averages and counts.
